title: SetTrackState locked (track lock / unlock)
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: SetTrackState writes only the existing locked flag on one video, audio, or caption track. The track's own lock does not block this meta-op, so unlock still works. A missing track is TRACK_NOT_FOUND. A no-op same-value lock does not rewrite the document.

After a video track is locked, opened clip edits refuse FIELD_LOCKED as a whole group and do not drop or retarget captions. SetCaptions on an unlocked caption track still applies. Locking the caption track refuses a changing SetCaptions with FIELD_LOCKED. Locking a persistent audio track refuses SetAudioTrackState mute/solo and clip edits on that track until it is unlocked.

A real UI path imports AV, extracts persistent audio, adds a clipLocal cue, locks the video track, undoes and redoes the lock, confirms a move is refused, unlocks, then moves the host so the cue follows, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

Video and caption muted/solo remain FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED at admission; audio muted/solo stay SetAudioTrackState; syncLock is not toggled here. Already-delivered insert-move leave-gap, explicit-range ripple close, includeLinks=false, leave-gap and ripple trim/delete, caption-aware MoveClip and LiftClips/Cut, field-aware invert, caption-aware overwrite, caption default/follow/interval/source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Source-interval crop stays ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host stays REF_NOT_FOUND. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, MP4 burn-in, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice.
